title: Why Google, OpenAI and Anthropic keep changing AI prices

youtube_title: Why Google, OpenAI and Anthropic keep changing AI prices
youtube_description:
Google, OpenAI and Anthropic keep changing their AI prices. How do you budget when the offer you sign up for can end?

Three rules for your next AI budget: budget at the full price, agree a price and an end date, and keep the freedom to switch.

Watch the explanation, then ask whoever owns your AI budget what each completed task costs.

More at makeyourmindup.ai
